connector.name: e-yearbook.com Archive Search
connector.registryDescription: Search over 300K U.S. yearbooks, over 100M mentions. Free preview; subscription unlocks scans.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.digitaldataonline.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.digitaldataonline.mcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>. Free public token at https://www.e-yearbook.com/for-ai-agents/. Paid tiers unlock get_person_summary and get_yearbook_report.
